armyRules.name: Sept Tenet: Superior Craftsmanship
armyRules.description:
- Add 4" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons that models with this tenet are equipped with.
- Each time a ranged attack is made with a weapon that has a Strength characteristic greater than the Toughness characteristic of a **VEHICLE** or **BATTLESUIT** unit with this tenet, subtract 2 from the Strength characteristic of that attack.

unitModifierGroup.comment: Campaign Sept Tenet: +4" Range on all ranged weapons

modifierGroups.comment: Seeker of Perfection: improve AP of the Warlord's ranged weapons by 1

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Each time this **^^Warlord^^** makes a ranged attack:
- Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
- An unmodified wound roll of 6 inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target in addition to any normal damage (to a maximum of 3 mortal wounds per phase).

rules.name: Overdrive Power Systems
rules.description: **COMMANDER** model only. Select up to two ranged weapons this model is equipped with. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack with one of those weapons that targets a unit within half range, add 1 to that attack’s wound roll.
